lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Thinking about a Pixel 11 in India? Here's the short answer first, then the evidence.
lines.say: Thinking about a Pixel eleven in India? Here's the short answer first, then the evidence.
lines.beat: Cold open: p11_family.png large, slow parallax. Title 'Pixel 11 lineup: should you buy one?'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: For most people, the base Pixel 11. Great camera and software, weak for heavy gaming.
lines.say: For most people, it's the base Pixel eleven. Great camera and great software, but weak for heavy gaming.
lines.beat: Provisional verdict card (accent): 'Most buyers → Pixel 11' with three pills: Camera ✓ · Software ✓ · Heavy gaming ✗. p11_frost.png.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The Pros take better zoom and night photos, but they're hard to justify at Pro prices.
lines.say: The Pros take better zoom and night photos, but they're hard to justify at Pro prices.
lines.beat: Second verdict card: 'Camera-first → 11 Pro / Pro XL' pills: Zoom ✓ · Night ✓ · Price ✗. pro_family.png.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: And the Fold is the toughest foldable around, with a battery that trails its rivals.
lines.say: And the Fold is the toughest foldable around, but its battery trails its rivals.
lines.beat: Third verdict card: 'Pro Fold → only if durability matters most' pills: IP68 ✓ · Battery ✗. fold_obsidian.png.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Full honesty: we haven't tested these phones ourselves. We read 35 reviews from 20 outlets.
lines.say: Full honesty: we haven't tested these phones ourselves. Instead, we read thirty-five reviews from twenty outlets.
lines.beat: Method card: big '35 reviews · 20 outlets'. Small text: 'We did not test these phones. Every claim links to a review in the description.'

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: We count each outlet once, and we always tell you how many of them actually covered a topic.
lines.say: We count each outlet once, and we always tell you how many of them actually covered that topic.
lines.beat: Example denominator graphic: '13 of 15 outlets' with 15 small dots, 13 lit. Caption 'Only outlets that covered the topic are counted'. Note: 'Tom's Guide, TechRadar & Android Central share a parent company'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: India prices: ₹89,999 for the Pixel 11, ₹1,19,999 for the Pro, ₹1,34,999 for the Pro XL.
lines.say: Indian prices: eighty-nine thousand, nine ninety-nine for the Pixel eleven. One lakh nineteen thousand, nine ninety-nine for the Pro. And one lakh thirty-four thousand, nine ninety-nine for the Pro XL.
lines.beat: Price table (Google Store India list, 256GB): Pixel 11 ₹89,999 · 11 Pro ₹1,19,999 · 11 Pro XL ₹1,34,999 · Pro Fold ₹1,86,999 (512GB only). Fade values in at final value, no count-up.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: The Fold is ₹1,86,999, 512GB only. And on Flipkart, prices were already lower on October 5th.
lines.say: The Fold is one lakh eighty-six thousand, nine ninety-nine, and only in five-twelve gigs. And on Flipkart, prices were already lower on October fifth.
lines.beat: Add a second column 'Flipkart, 5 Oct 2026': ₹77,999 · ₹1,09,999 · ₹1,24,999 · ₹1,76,999 with note 'Prices change daily, check before buying'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: So what changed from the Pixel 10? Start with what Google says.
lines.say: So what changed from the Pixel ten? Let's start with what Google says.
lines.beat: Header 'What Google says is new' with .tag-claim 'Google claims'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Tensor G6: Google claims 50% more AI compute, 25% faster browsing and 15% faster app launches.
lines.say: The Tensor G six chip. Google claims fifty percent more A.I. compute, about twenty-five percent faster browsing, and fifteen percent faster app launches.
lines.beat: tensor_g6.png with slow 3D tilt; three bars labelled .tag-claim 'Google claims (not independent tests)'. Values fade in at final value.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Every model now starts at 256GB, and wireless charging goes to 25 watts with magnets.
lines.say: Every model now starts at two fifty-six gigs, and wireless charging goes up to twenty-five watts, with magnets.
lines.beat: Two tiles: '256GB base storage' and '25W Qi2.2 magnetic (Pixelsnap)'. pro_social.jpg as background card at low opacity is fine.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: The base model's camera bar is 40% thinner. The Pros get brighter, tougher screens.
lines.say: The base model's camera bar is forty percent thinner. The Pros get brighter, tougher screens.
lines.beat: Split: left p11_frost.png with badge 'Pixel 11' and callout '40% thinner camera bar (Google)'; right pro_family.png with badge 'Pixel 11 Pro + Pro XL' and '3,600 nits peak · 2× scratch resistance (Google)'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: But the Pro and Pro XL now start with 12GB of RAM, down from 16. Ten of 15 Pro outlets criticised that.
lines.say: But the Pro and Pro XL now start with twelve gigs of RAM, down from sixteen. Ten of the fifteen outlets that reviewed them criticised that.
lines.beat: Bad stat '16GB → 12GB RAM (base Pro / Pro XL)' + denominator dots '10 of 15 outlets'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: And HiLight, the new notification light on the Pros. Thirteen of 15 outlets said it barely does anything.
lines.say: And then there's high-light, the new notification light on the Pros. Thirteen of the fifteen outlets said it barely does anything.
lines.beat: pro_social.jpg with a soft colour glow ring; '13 of 15 outlets: HiLight does too little' (bad).

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: As of October 5th it still only lights up for favourite contacts' calls and Gemini. A beta adds messages.
lines.say: As of October fifth, it still only lights up for calls from favourite contacts, and for Gemini. A beta version adds messages.
lines.beat: Status card 'Checked 5 Oct 2026': Stable: calls from favourites + Gemini · Beta (Android 17 QPR2): messages from favourites.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Question one: is the screen good? Reviewers mostly agree, yes.
lines.say: Question one: is the screen good? Reviewers mostly agree. Yes.
lines.beat: Question title card 'Is the screen good?' then verdict chip 'Mostly yes'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Twelve of 14 Pro outlets praised it. For the base model, six of the seven that covered it.
lines.say: Twelve of the fourteen outlets that covered the Pro screens praised them. For the base model, it was six of the seven.
lines.beat: Two separate panels with their own badges: 'Pixel 11 Pro + Pro XL: 12 of 14 praised' and 'Pixel 11: 6 of 7 praised' (dot graphics).

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: One nuance. Google's brightness figures are peak ratings. Independent tests came in a bit lower.
lines.say: One nuance. Google's brightness numbers are peak ratings. The independent tests came in a little lower.
lines.beat: Two panels, NOT one scale: Panel A .tag-claim 'Google peak rating': Pixel 11 3,000 nits · Pro 3,600 nits. Panel B .tag-measured 'Measured by GSMArena (10% window, auto)': Pixel 11 ~2,800 · Pro XL 3,118.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Two catches on the base Pixel 11: it ships at 60 hertz, and it has no LTPO panel.
lines.say: Two catches on the base Pixel eleven: it ships at sixty hertz by default, and it doesn't have an L T P O panel.
lines.beat: Badge Pixel 11. Chips '60Hz by default (switch to 120Hz in settings)' and 'No LTPO'. Small '3 of 7 outlets called it a drawback'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: And if screen flicker bothers you, three Pro reviewers flagged low-frequency PWM dimming. Try one in a store first.
lines.say: And if screen flicker bothers you, three Pro reviewers flagged low frequency P W M dimming. Try one in a store first.
lines.beat: Warn card 'PWM dimming: flagged by 3 of 15 Pro outlets' + 'Video can't show flicker: try it in person'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Question two: is it fast enough? For everyday use, yes.
lines.say: Question two: is it fast enough? For everyday use, yes.
lines.beat: Question title 'Is it fast enough?'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Eleven of 13 Pro outlets and seven of 10 base-model outlets called daily use smooth.
lines.say: Eleven of thirteen Pro outlets, and seven of ten base model outlets, called daily use smooth.
lines.beat: Two panels with badges: Pro+XL '11 of 13 smooth', Pixel 11 '7 of 10 smooth' (good).

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Gaming is the weak spot. Seven of 13 Pro outlets criticised it, and five more had mixed feelings.
lines.say: Gaming is the weak spot. Seven of thirteen Pro outlets criticised it, and five more were mixed.
lines.beat: Stacked bar 13 segments: 7 criticised (bad) · 5 mixed (warn) · 1 praised (good). Label 'GPU / gaming, Pixel 11 Pro + Pro XL'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Genshin Impact was broken at launch. A game patch fixed that, but a new stutter appeared in September.
lines.say: Genshin Impact was broken at launch. A game patch fixed that, but a new stutter showed up after the September updates.
lines.beat: Timeline graphic: 'Launch: broken' → 'Game patch: fixed' → 'Sept updates: new stutter (ANGLE)'. Small: 'Status checked 5 Oct 2026'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Workaround: Developer options, ANGLE preferences, set Genshin to native. Google hadn't fixed it yet.
lines.say: The workaround is in Developer options. Under ANGLE preferences, set Genshin to native. Google hadn't fixed it yet.
lines.beat: Settings path chips: Developer options › ANGLE Preferences › Genshin Impact › Native.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: What about heat? One reviewer in Phoenix, in desert heat, saw camera features shut off.
lines.say: What about heat? One reviewer in Phoenix, in desert heat, saw camera features switch off.
lines.beat: Card 'Field report: Android Authority, outdoors in Phoenix (>100°F typical)': 'Camera turned off zoom features: device too warm'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: In lab stress tests it ran about the same as the Pixel 10, or a few degrees cooler. That's not a contradiction.
lines.say: But in lab stress tests, it ran about the same as the Pixel ten, or a few degrees cooler. Those two findings don't contradict each other.
lines.beat: Second panel '.tag-measured Lab stress test (3DMark)': Android Authority 46°C peak 'on par with Pixel 10' · Android Headlines ~40°C, ~3°C cooler than Pixel 10. Note 'Different conditions: not a head-to-head'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Takeaway: normal use, fine. Heavy gaming, or a very hot day outdoors, and it can struggle.
lines.say: So, the takeaway. In normal use, you're fine. Heavy gaming, or a very hot day outdoors, and it can struggle.
lines.beat: Takeaway card with two rows: 'Everyday use ✓' · 'Heavy gaming / extreme heat ✗'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The camera is why most people buy a Pixel. So let's look at actual photos.
lines.say: The camera is why most people buy a Pixel. So let's look at actual photos.
lines.beat: Header 'The camera'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: First, a caveat. These are Google's own samples: best-case marketing shots, not independent tests.
lines.say: First, a caveat. These are Google's own samples. They're best-case marketing shots, not independent tests.
lines.beat: Disclosure card: 'Photos on the next screens: Google-published samples. Model not stated by Google. Chosen by Google to look good.' Then sample 08 full frame. Label each sample: 'Pixel 11 series (model not stated) | <lens or 'not stated'> | <mode or 'not stated'> | Source: Google sample'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: They show what the camera can do. Reviewers tell us how often it actually does it.
lines.say: They show what the camera can do at its best. The reviewers tell us how often it actually does it.
lines.beat: Sample 08 (outfit portrait) and 10 (low-angle group) full-frame, each ≥3s, with labels (lens 'not stated'; card says 50MP main / 48MP ultrawide).

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Everyday photos: all 15 outlets that reviewed the Pros praised them. That's unanimous.
lines.say: Everyday photos. All fifteen outlets that reviewed the Pros praised them. That's unanimous.
lines.beat: Badge Pro + Pro XL. Big '15 of 15 praised stills' over sample 09 (colourful wall portrait) shown full, labelled.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: For the base Pixel 11, five of eight praised it, and three had mixed views.
lines.say: For the base Pixel eleven, five of eight praised it, and three had mixed views.
lines.beat: Badge Pixel 11. Stacked bar 8: 5 praised · 3 mixed.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Night photos: all 11 Pro outlets that covered it said Night Sight is now faster.
lines.say: Night photos. All eleven Pro outlets that covered it said Night Sight is now faster.
lines.beat: Sample 01 (Instant Night Sight portrait under stars) full frame ≥3s, label mode 'Instant Night Sight (Google alt text)'. Then '11 of 11: faster Night Sight'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Selfies use a 42 megapixel front camera, according to Google. This is Google's own example.
lines.say: Selfies use a forty-two megapixel front camera, according to Google. This is Google's own example.
lines.beat: Sample 11 (selfie) full frame ≥3s with label (lens: front camera implied by Google's card).

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Zoom. The base Pixel 11 has a 5x telephoto, and Google says up to 30x Super Zoom.
lines.say: Now, zoom. The base Pixel eleven has a five x telephoto lens, and Google says it goes up to thirty x with Super Zoom.
lines.beat: Badge Pixel 11. Zoom ladder graphic 1× · 5× (optical tele) · 30× (Super Zoom, Google claim). Then samples 14 → 15 (30x frame), labelled 'Frame from Google demo video'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The Pros go to 120x. But Google says past 30x, generative AI rebuilds the image.
lines.say: The Pros go all the way to a hundred and twenty x. But Google itself says that past thirty x, generative A.I. rebuilds the image.
lines.beat: Badge Pro + Pro XL. Sample 16 (120x moon frame) with a prominent label 'AI-reconstructed by Google's own description · Frame from Google demo video'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Eight of 13 Pro outlets criticised 120x zoom for invented detail. Only one praised it.
lines.say: And eight of thirteen Pro outlets criticised the one-twenty x zoom for inventing detail. Only one praised it.
lines.beat: Stacked bar 13: 8 criticised · 4 mixed · 1 praised. Label 'Use 120x for fun, not for evidence'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Moving kids and pets? Magic Capture tries to pick the best frame. Seven of 14 Pro outlets liked it.
lines.say: Moving kids and pets? Magic Capture tries to pick the sharpest moment. Seven of fourteen Pro outlets liked it.
lines.beat: Card 'Magic Capture' with stacked bar 14: 7 praised · 2 mixed · 1 criticised · 4 neutral. Note 'No Google still of a moving subject was available'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Google's group-photo tricks, Add Me and Auto Best Take, look like this in its own demos.
lines.say: Google's group photo tricks, Add Me and Auto Best Take, look like this, in Google's own demos.
lines.beat: Before/after pairs side by side: samples 17→18 (Add Me) then 19→20 (Auto Best Take), labelled 'Frame from Google demo video'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Video? Only six of 15 Pro outlets actually judged it. So we can't call it good or bad.
lines.say: And video? Only six of fifteen Pro outlets actually judged it. So we can't honestly call it good or bad.
lines.beat: 'Not enough evidence' card (warn): 'Video judged by 6 of 15 outlets'. Distinguish 'not examined' from 'good'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Camera takeaway: Pixel photos are excellent. The Pros add better zoom and faster night shots.
lines.say: Camera takeaway. Pixel photos are excellent. The Pros add better zoom and faster night shots.
lines.beat: Takeaway card two columns: Pixel 11 '5x tele, excellent stills' | Pro/XL '+ better tele, faster Night Sight, 120x (AI)'. Camera Looks sample 03 (flower, Velvet) as backdrop.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Will it last a day? For the base Pixel 11, nine of 10 outlets said battery life is good.
lines.say: Will it last a day? For the base Pixel eleven, nine of ten outlets said the battery is good.
lines.beat: Question title 'Will it last a day?' then '9 of 10 outlets: good battery' dots.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: But the hours you'll hear differ wildly, because each outlet runs a different test.
lines.say: But the hours you'll hear differ wildly, because each outlet runs a different test.
lines.beat: Three SEPARATE panels, no shared axis, each with its condition.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Tom's Guide browsed the web non-stop over 5G: 12 hours 45 minutes.
lines.say: Tom's Guide browsed the web non-stop over 5G, and got twelve hours, forty-five minutes.
lines.beat: Panel 1 .tag-measured 'Tom's Guide · continuous web browsing over 5G' → 12h 45m.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: PCMag streamed YouTube on Wi-Fi at full brightness: 19 hours 13 minutes.
lines.say: PCMag streamed YouTube on Wi-Fi at full brightness, and got nineteen hours, thirteen minutes.
lines.beat: Panel 2 .tag-measured 'PCMag · YouTube over Wi-Fi, full brightness' → 19h 13m.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: And The Guardian, in light real-world use, got about 54 hours between charges.
lines.say: And The Guardian, in light real-world use, got about fifty-four hours between charges.
lines.beat: Panel 3 'The Guardian · light real-world use, time between charges' → ~54h.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: None of those numbers is your day. Compared with each outlet's own Pixel 10 result, it's about the same.
lines.say: None of those numbers is your day. But compared with each outlet's own Pixel ten result, it's about the same as last year.
lines.beat: Summary 'Same-test comparison vs Pixel 10: within a few percent either way'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The Pro XL was equal or better than last year in most tests. The smaller Pro depends on the test.
lines.say: The Pro XL was equal or better than last year in most tests. For the smaller Pro, it depends on the test.
lines.beat: Two panels: Pro XL 'equal or better than Pixel 10 Pro XL in most tests' · Pro 'flat in one lab, better in another'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Charging: no charger in the box. Pixel 11 and Pro reach about half to 60% in 30 minutes.
lines.say: Charging. There's no charger in the box. The Pixel eleven and the Pro reach about fifty to sixty percent in thirty minutes.
lines.beat: Card 'In the box: phone, USB-C cable, SIM tool, no charger'. Then milestone bar '30 min ≈ 50–60% · full in 80–98 min' (.tag-measured, multiple outlets).

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The Pro XL's 45 watt speed only works with a 21 volt PPS charger. With one, GSMArena got 72% in 30 minutes.
lines.say: The Pro XL's forty-five watt charging only works with a twenty-one volt P P S charger. With the right one, GSMArena got seventy-two percent in thirty minutes.
lines.beat: Badge Pixel 11 Pro XL. Warn chip 'Needs a 21V PPS charger'. .tag-measured 'GSMArena · Google 67W charger' → 72% in 30 min.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Magnetic wireless charging, though: no outlet that covered it complained.
lines.say: Magnetic wireless charging, though? Not one outlet that covered it complained.
lines.beat: Good chip '25W Qi2.2 magnetic: 0 complaints (6 of 9 base, 7 of 11 Pro praised)'.

parts.title: Software, AI, and living with it in India

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Software. Every Pixel 11 gets seven years of updates, and reviewers called it the cleanest Android.
lines.say: Software. Every Pixel eleven gets seven years of updates, and reviewers called it the cleanest Android out there.
lines.beat: Big '7 years of OS + security updates' (Google) with a timeline to 2033.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: The standout new feature is Rambler voice typing. Eleven of 13 Pro outlets praised it.
lines.say: The standout new feature is Rambler voice typing. Eleven of thirteen Pro outlets praised it.
lines.beat: 'Rambler: 11 of 13 praised' dots.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: And for India: Google says it works in Hindi and other Indian languages, even switching mid-sentence.
lines.say: And for India, Google says it works in Hindi and other Indian languages, even switching mid-sentence.
lines.beat: India card 'Rambler in India: Hindi + other supported Indian languages, mixed-language' (.tag-claim 'Google says').

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Proactive Assistance is weaker: six of 11 Pro outlets said it rarely shows up. In India it's English only.
lines.say: Proactive Assistance is weaker. Six of eleven Pro outlets said it rarely shows up. And in India, it's English only.
lines.beat: Bad bar '6 of 11 criticised' + India chip 'Proactive Assistance: English only in India'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: And Gemini doing tasks inside apps for you is US and Korea only right now.
lines.say: And Gemini doing tasks inside your apps is U.S. and Korea only, right now.
lines.beat: Availability table checked 5 Oct 2026: Gemini in-app tasks: US, Korea ✓ · India ✗.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Daily-use stuff reviewers liked: a fast ultrasonic fingerprint reader, and face unlock that works for banking apps.
lines.say: Daily use stuff that reviewers liked: a fast ultrasonic fingerprint reader, and face unlock that works for banking apps.
lines.beat: Icon row: ultrasonic fingerprint ✓ · face unlock for banking/payments ✓ · nano SIM + eSIM.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Calls and 5G? The new modem did well in US tests, but no one tested it on Jio, Airtel or Vi.
lines.say: Calls and 5G? The new modem did well in U.S. tests. But nobody tested it on Jio, Airtel, or Vi.
lines.beat: 'Not examined in India' card (warn): 'Modem tested on US networks only'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Known bug: some routers cause overnight standby drain. Switching the router to Wi-Fi 5 helps.
lines.say: One known bug. Some Wi-Fi routers cause battery drain overnight. Switching the router to Wi-Fi five helps.
lines.beat: Bug card 'Wi-Fi standby drain with some routers · workaround: router to Wi-Fi 5 · not fixed as of 5 Oct'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Service: one-year warranty, and Google's own service centres in Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad and Bangalore.
lines.say: For service, there's a one year warranty, and Google's own service centres in Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, and Bangalore.
lines.beat: India map-style card with 4 city pins + '20+ walk-in centres' + '1-year warranty'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Bonus: the Pro, Pro XL and Fold include six months of Google AI Pro. The base model doesn't.
lines.say: And a bonus. The Pro, Pro XL and Fold include six months of Google A.I. Pro. The base model doesn't.
lines.beat: Offer card '6 months Google AI Pro (₹11,700 value): Pro, Pro XL, Fold only · Pixel 11: 3 months YouTube Premium only'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Now the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. ₹1,86,999, 512GB only, and only in Olive in India.
lines.say: Now, the Pixel eleven Pro Fold. One lakh, eighty-six thousand, nine ninety-nine. Five-twelve gigs only, and only in Olive, in India.
lines.beat: fold_social.jpg full frame reveal, then fold_obsidian.png; price chips '₹1,86,999 · 512GB · Olive (India)'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Its biggest strength: it's still the only mainstream foldable rated IP68. Eight of nine outlets praised that.
lines.say: Its biggest strength? It's still the only mainstream foldable with an I P sixty-eight rating. Eight of nine outlets praised that.
lines.beat: Good '8 of 9: IP68 dust + water'. Quote card (read verbatim next line) prepared.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: 9to5Google: “this is the only mainstream foldable with an IP68 dust/water resistance rating.”
lines.say: Nine to five Google put it simply: this is the only mainstream foldable with an I P sixty-eight dust and water resistance rating.
lines.beat: Quote card exactly: “this is the only mainstream foldable with an IP68 dust/water resistance rating” — 9to5Google.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: The weak spot is battery. Seven of nine criticised it, and it trailed rivals in every same-test comparison.
lines.say: The weak spot is battery. Seven of nine criticised it, and it trailed its rivals in every same-test comparison.
lines.beat: Bad '7 of 9 criticised battery' + 'Behind Razr Fold and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra in same-test comparisons'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The crease: four of seven who covered it said it's visible. Droid Life didn't mind it.
lines.say: The crease? Four of the seven who covered it said it's clearly visible. Droid Life didn't mind it.
lines.beat: Stacked bar 7: 4 criticised · 1 praised · 2 mixed/neutral. Note 'A crease is best judged in person, under angled light'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Camera opinions split two against two. 9to5Google: “If I were to choose a foldable (in the US) purely on camera, it’d have to be the Pixel.”
lines.say: Camera opinions split, two against two. Nine to five Google said: If I were to choose a foldable, in the U.S., purely on camera, it'd have to be the Pixel.
lines.beat: Split card '2 praised · 2 criticised (of 9)': left quote exactly “If I were to choose a foldable (in the US) purely on camera, it’d have to be the Pixel.” — 9to5Google; right 'Android Authority: portraits below par' (text, not a quote card).

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Multitasking was a bright spot: six of nine praised it.
lines.say: Multitasking was a bright spot. Six of nine praised it.
lines.beat: Good '6 of 9 praised multitasking'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Fold verdict: buy it if durability matters most. Skip it if you want the longest battery or play games.
lines.say: Fold verdict. Buy it if durability matters most to you. Skip it if you want the longest battery, or you play games.
lines.beat: Buy | Skip two columns: Buy 'durability first · Pixel software fans' | Skip 'battery-first · gamers · Pixel 10 Pro Fold owners'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: So, which one should you buy? Here's our recommendation, by the kind of buyer you are.
lines.say: So, which one should you buy? Here's our recommendation, based on what kind of buyer you are.
lines.beat: Title 'Which one should you buy?' + .tag-editorial 'Our recommendation, based on 35 reviews'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Most people: the Pixel 11. Excellent photos and the same software, for ₹30,000 less than the Pro.
lines.say: Most people: the Pixel eleven. You get excellent photos and the same software, for thirty thousand rupees less than the Pro.
lines.beat: Row 1 of recommendation table: 'Most buyers → Pixel 11 · ₹89,999 list'. 'You give up: 120Hz by default, LTPO, 120x zoom, AI Pro offer'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Camera lovers who zoom a lot: the Pixel 11 Pro. Better telephoto, faster Night Sight.
lines.say: Camera lovers who zoom a lot: the Pixel eleven Pro. Better telephoto, faster Night Sight.
lines.beat: Row 2: 'Zoom + night photos → Pixel 11 Pro · ₹1,19,999'. 'Costs ₹30,000 more · base RAM cut to 12GB'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Big screen and the biggest battery: the Pro XL. Just budget for a 21 volt PPS charger.
lines.say: If you want a big screen and the biggest battery: the Pro XL. Just budget for a twenty-one volt P P S charger.
lines.beat: Row 3: 'Big screen + battery → Pixel 11 Pro XL · ₹1,34,999'. 'Extra cost: compatible PPS charger'.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Durability above all, in a foldable: the Pro Fold, at ₹1,86,999.
lines.say: And if you want durability above all, in a foldable: the Pro Fold, at one lakh, eighty-six thousand, nine ninety-nine.
lines.beat: Row 4: 'Toughest foldable → Pro Fold · ₹1,86,999'. 'You give up: battery life vs rivals'.

lines.speaker: leo
lines.text: Who should skip? Serious mobile gamers, and anyone with a Pixel 10. Most reviewers who addressed upgrading said wait.
lines.say: Who should skip it? Serious mobile gamers, and anyone with a Pixel ten. Most reviewers who addressed upgrading said wait.
lines.beat: Skip panel (bad): 'Serious mobile gamers' · 'Pixel 10 owners'. Upgrade panel (good): 'Pixel 9 or older · iPhone switchers'.

lines.speaker: maya
